question: Select the sentence that contains a spelling error.

options.text: Fermented apple juice is touted to have many health benefits though most are anecdotal and not supported by scientific facts.
Intriguing as it is, the house was never sold because it was thought to be haunted.
It is important for scientists to acknowledge their humanity and the implications of their inventions.
There are many believes about ancient artefacts that some of them are patently not true.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"believes"** is a verb that means to accept something as true; feel sure of the truth of. (विश्वास करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She believes in fairies and magical creatures.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"beliefs"** is a noun that means something one accepts as true or real; a firmly held opinion. (मान्यताएँ)
 
 
• **Example: **There are many beliefs about the supernatural in different cultures.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: Fermented (किण्वित) apple juice is touted to have many health benefits though most are anecdotal and not supported by scientific facts.

 
 
• **Example:** Fermented foods are believed to improve gut health.
 
 
 
• **Option 2**: Intriguing (रोचक) as it is, the house was never sold because it was thought to be haunted.
 
 
• **Example:** The intriguing mystery novel kept me hooked until the last page.
 
 
 
• **Option 3**: It is important for scientists to acknowledge (स्वीकार करना) their humanity and the implications of their inventions.
 
 
• **Example:** She refused to acknowledge that she had made a mistake.
